setting.sl: Tvoj avto je na servisu v Keswicku na tehničnem pregledu (MOT). Danes ob petih bi ga {m:moral|f:morala} prevzeti, jutri zjutraj pa ga potrebuješ za službo. Zazvoni telefon: kličejo s servisa, nekaj je narobe.
setting.de: Dein Auto ist zur Hauptuntersuchung (MOT) in einer Werkstatt in Keswick. Heute um fünf solltest du es abholen, und morgen früh brauchst du es für die Arbeit. Das Telefon läutet: die Werkstatt, es gibt ein Problem.
setting.it: La tua macchina è in un'officina di Keswick per la revisione (il MOT). Oggi alle cinque dovevi ritirarla, e domani mattina ti serve per andare al lavoro. Squilla il telefono: è l'officina, c'è un problema.
setting.en: Your car is at a garage in Keswick for its MOT. You were going to collect it at five today, and you need it for work tomorrow morning. The phone rings: it's the garage, and there's a problem.

role: Darren, at the service desk of a garage in Keswick, on the phone. Sorry but busy: the car failed its MOT (the brake pads, a front tyre), the pads come on Thursday. Offers Friday; a courtesy car only if one comes back, else a lift to the bus. Gives the price when asked.

goals.en: Explain why you need the car tomorrow
goals.de: Erklär, warum du das Auto morgen brauchst
goals.it: Spiega perché ti serve la macchina domani

goals.en: Ask what the repair will cost
Ask for a courtesy car or another way
goals.sl: Prosi za nadomestni avto ali drugo rešitev
goals.de: Bitte um einen Leihwagen oder eine andere Lösung
goals.it: Chiedi un'auto di cortesia o un'altra soluzione

goals.en: Agree on a new time to collect it
goals.sl: Dogovori se za nov čas prevzema
goals.it: Concorda un nuovo orario per ritirarla

opener_sl: Hello, it's Darren from the garage. I'm sorry, but I'm afraid your car won't be ready today.

opener_en.sl: Dober dan, kliče Darren s servisa. Žal mi je, ampak vaš avto danes ne bo gotov.
opener_en.de: Hallo, hier ist Darren von der Werkstatt. Es tut mir leid, aber Ihr Auto wird heute nicht fertig.
opener_en.it: Salve, sono Darren dell'officina. Mi dispiace, ma purtroppo la sua macchina oggi non sarà pronta.
opener_en.en: Hello, this is Darren at the garage. Sorry, but your car won't be ready today.

en.sl: O ne. Kaj pa je narobe?
en.de: Oh nein. Was ist denn das Problem?
en.it: Oh no. Qual è il problema?

vocabulary_hints.sl: But you said it would be ready at five.

en.en: But you told me it would be ready at five.

vocabulary_hints.sl: I need it for work tomorrow morning.

vocabulary_hints.sl: How much will the repair cost?
